scope: Full published development OOF benchmarks, ten matches and five outer folds; distinct from screen49 six-fit/two-validation diagnostics.
binning: Exact existing benchmark implementations; pass equal-count groups on success scores, drive quantile edges on success scores. Plots reflect to loss probability without rebinding.
physical_outer_fit: Eight matches; two test; isotonic uses internal six-fit/two-held predictions within the eight.
ball_drive_comparison: Previous and updated coefficients evaluated on the identical retained 9114-row/456-loss OBE-verified cohort, not a comparison against the original9148-row benchmark.
distinct_from_screen: These are full five-fold OOF physical benchmarks, not the two-validation-match six-fit feature diagnostics or the full-ten-match deployment refits.
